about: Cascoon's skeleton for tools/models/rig_static.mjs (the upstream export is a static mesh). Positions in the upstream file's units (+Z forward, +X its left). A cocoon: a body chain up its middle (Hips at the base, Spine, Head at the top) so it can squash, lean and wobble; Opening marks the silk opening in its front between the eyes (String Shot and Poison Sting leave it); a bone per silk strand that doesn't touch the ground, to quiver on springs (the strands it rests on stay with the body). Placed from the mesh: the body chain on the axis of the ellipsoid its silk body fits, each strand's bone from where the strand leaves that ellipsoid to its tip; each strand's region holds the part of it outside the body, so the strand flexes at its root and the body stays whole.
